body: Task & link index caches (apps/chrome-ext/src/app/taskIndex.ts, linkIndex.ts) are keyed by fileId, store FNV-1a content-hash + parsed array + path + parsedAt; re-parse only on hash mismatch; no eviction (designed for ~1000 files). Backlinks component reads linkIndex. Scroll-to-task: store.openTaskLocation bumps scrollTarget.rev (re-triggerable); Viewer polls DOM li[data-fv-task-line=N] max 20x at 100ms (render+task-context lag), adds fv-task-flash class for 1.5s.
